newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel lower against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel lower against dollar.

text.p: The Israeli shekel weakened slightly against the dollar on Monday in quiet trading, dealers said.
"The session opened with a decline of the shekel, but when it reached 3.5450 shekels (per dollar) investors started converting dollars into shekels," said a dealer at Israel Discount Bank.
"The shekel rebounded to 3.5400 and the market stabilised at this level remaining almost unchanged for the rest of the trading day," he said.
He said the shekel gained against the mark after the dollar rose to a new 94-month high against the German currency at 1.8730.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.5410 shekels compared with 3.5370 on Friday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.7651 against 3.7743 on Friday.
On the crosses, the shekel traded against the yen at 2.9824 shekels per 100 yen compared with 2.9723 on Friday, and against the mark at 1.8916 shekels compared with 1.9156 on Friday.
In late afternoon, the dollar was trading at 3.5400 shekels.
- Dan Gerstenfeld, Tel Aviv newsroom, 972-3-537-2211 x233
